street.label: Night street
street.hint: A road between two buildings: sidewalks, shop and bar fronts, doors, parked cars, streetlamps.

alley.label: Back alley
alley.hint: A narrow alley behind buildings: back doors, dumpsters, fire escapes, puddles, a chain-link fence.

rooftop.label: Rooftop
rooftop.hint: A flat roof with a parapet: air-conditioning units, vents, a stair hut, and a lower roof across a gap.

warehouse.label: Warehouse
warehouse.hint: A warehouse floor: crate stacks, shelving rows, a forklift, a loading-bay roll door and a small office.

office.label: Office floor
office.hint: A corporate floor: lobby with a security desk, cubicles, private offices, a glass meeting room, elevators and a server room.

club.label: Nightclub
club.hint: A bar and club: the bar counter, booths, a neon dance floor, a stage, a back room and a staff door.

sewer.label: Sewer junction
sewer.hint: Sewer tunnels: a water channel with walkways, a junction, a ladder up and a maintenance room.

garage.label: Parking garage
garage.hint: A parking level: concrete pillars, painted bays, parked cars, a ramp, a stairwell and a utility room.

docks.label: Docks at night
docks.hint: A quay and a pier over dark water: container stacks, a crane, bollards and a warehouse door.

forest.label: Forest clearing
forest.hint: A wooded clearing with a dirt track, a campfire, a fallen log and a ruined shack.

astral.label: Astral plane
astral.hint: The astral plane: a violet haze, drifting motes and faint auras. No walls.

astral-city.label: Astral city block
astral-city.hint: The astral reflection of a street corner: ghostly buildings and glowing living auras. No walls.

matrix-host.label: Matrix host
matrix-host.hint: A host's sculpted interior: an I/O port, the CPU core, a datastore and a slave node joined by light-paths.

matrix-grid.label: Matrix grid
matrix-grid.hint: The open grid: a lattice of datalines with distant host icons. No walls.
